deploy-bot: [1716004321] Starting deploy: prod-canary schema migration add_event_owner_idx_v2
vivian: heads-up — validation hooks are enabled; if constraint_validation_v2 fails it'll abort.
rahul: saw a canary auto-abort: constraint_validation_v2 failed on 7 shards, owner_id nulls after backfill :warning:
jordan: what did the backfill do? transactional or upsert streaming?
vivian: streaming upserts in batches (50k), non-transactional. suspected race with writer flow that allows temporary nulls.
ops-oncall: there was a traffic surge at 03:12 UTC that coincides with canary window :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
rahul: deploy-bot shows rollback started. we need a remediation plan before re-attempt.
liz: recommend: 1) fully revert canary (pin to previous service image) 2) pause schema rollout 3) run targeted diagnostics metric owner_null_count per shard
jordan: +1. Also split backfill into tenant-range jobs (<=20k rows) with 30s sleep and circuit-breaker on error.
vivian: alternative: fill default owner_id for rows where it's NULL instead of leaving them for index - safer for constraint.
ops-oncall: don't forget alerts: add alarm for validation-failures and set pager policy to SLO on rollouts.
rahul: proposed commands for rollback (manual):
```
# rollback canary to previous image
kubectl -n prod set image deployment/api api=redwood/api:release-2026-03-14
# pause rollout
kubectl -n prod rollout pause deployment/schema-migrator
```
vivian: once rollback is done we'll run dry-run backfill on staging with same traffic profile. don't use `--skip-validate` in prod.
jordan: plan of record:
- manual rollback now (rahul + ops-oncall)
- create small tenant-range backfill job with owner_null_count checks
- re-run constraint_validation_v2 against canary in staging -> then prod canary
- if green, re-attempt canary with version pinned and flag gating
liz: add release note blurb: "Canary aborted: constraint validation detected NULL owner_id; backfill strategy updated to batched tenant-range jobs and default-filling to avoid index fail". I'll draft it.
deploy-bot: [1716004388] Canary auto-abort event recorded: constraint_validation_v2 failed -> rollback hook executed :white_check_mark:
rahul: I'm going to start rollback now, ping when completed. ops-oncall please hold the migration window until we confirm backfill fix.
ops-oncall: holding window, will update calendar slot to WIP.
liz: thanks — tagging product to update release notes and customer comms later.
deploy-bot: [1716004399] Rollback completed for canary, service image rollback to release-2026-03-14. Logs: /deploy/logs/1716004321/rollback.log
